original_ai_output.title_zh: 消防部门称在纳萨拉瓦州挽回13亿奈拉财产
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦消防局表示，2026年1月至10月期间在纳萨拉瓦州13个地方政府辖区的火灾中挽回了价值13亿奈拉的财产。该州消防负责人Eno Nwachukwu在拉菲亚举行的2026年全国防火周宣传活动上披露，同期约有价值21亿奈拉的财产受到火灾威胁，估计损失约8亿奈拉。该局在此期间共接到约97起紧急报警。上述数据为单一来源，尚未获得交叉验证。

location.raw_text: Nasarawa State; Federal Secretariat in Lafia

key_facts.fact: 联邦消防局称2026年1月至10月在纳萨拉瓦州挽回价值13亿奈拉的财产
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Fire Service says it saved properties worth N1.3bn from fire incidents across the 13 local government areas of Nasarawa State between January and October 2026.

key_facts.fact: 同期约21亿奈拉财产受火灾威胁，估计损失约8亿奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She said properties worth N2.1bn were exposed to fire hazards during the period, while an estimated N800m worth of property was lost in fire incidents.

key_facts.fact: 该局在此期间接到约97起紧急报警
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the service received about 97 emergency calls between January and October.

key_facts.fact: 相关数据在拉菲亚联邦秘书处全国防火周活动上披露
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: disclosed this on Monday during the flag-off of the 2026 National Fire Week Awareness Campaign at the Federal Secretariat in Lafia, the state capital.

uncertainties: 火灾损失与挽回财产数据由消防部门单方面披露，尚未获得独立核实
目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
